subject: EOQ evidence summation, final OKR marks, and leadership priority pledges
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-analytics <ops@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ evidence summation, initial marks + leadership pledges

Team — attaching the condensed evidence pack and the working scores sheet for the EOQ OKR pass. This is the version I pulled after the scoring calls yesterday (v3). Highlights:

- Scoring approach: I used the judgement matrix we agreed on (impact, measurability, evidence quality). Where evidence was thin I added a short rationale column in the sheet.
- Items I’d like leadership sign-off on: RB-Platform reliability (contested), Developer self-serve funnel (needs narrative), and Customer expansion motion (score locked but ask for pledge on next quarter).
- Proposed leadership priority pledges (separate md): 90-day focused asks so the QBR narrative shows active handoffs instead of passive notes.

Immediate asks: please scan the evidence pack pages 2–6 for the RB-Platform reliability evidence and either: (a) accept the 6/10 with the existing rationale, (b) propose an explicit reduction to 5/10 with reasoning, or (c) request we move the objective to ‘carry forward’ with remediation actions in the pledges doc.

Deadlines: I need final sign-offs (or explicit dissent) by 2pm PT today so I can bake the leader narrative and QBR slide deck before the 5pm ops pass.

Attachments: EOQ_evidence_pack_MINA_v3.pdf; okr_scores_master.ods; leadership_priority_pledges.md

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EOQ evidence summation, initial marks + leadership pledges

Thanks Mina — good tidy pack. Two quick notes from my side:

1) RB-Platform reliability: I reviewed the incident cadence appendix. The mitigation work was reactive and the postmortem shows two repeat failure modes. I think 6/10 is generous; suggest 5/10 unless we can point to a concrete behavioral change (e.g., automated regression tests + SLO rebaselining) that moved the needle during the quarter.

2) Developer funnel: the adoption metric looks solid, but the qualitative signals in the CS notes show onboarding drop-offs in week 1. We should surface that as a narrative risk (not just a score).

If we downgrade reliability to 5, I'm ok with a leadership pledge that commits a cross-functional plan and a named owner (Platform Eng + CS). If anyone strongly objects, call it out here and tell me why we should keep 6.

—Vivek

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EOQ evidence summation, initial marks + leadership pledges

On Tue, May 18, 2027 at 10:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Mina — good tidy pack. Two quick notes from my side:
>
> 1) RB-Platform reliability: I reviewed the incident cadence appendix. The mitigation work was reactive and the postmortem shows two repeat failure modes. I think 6/10 is generous; suggest 5/10 unless we can point to a concrete behavioral change (e.g., automated regression tests + SLO rebaselining) that moved the needle during the quarter.

Agree with Vivek on the reliability score. To add context: the recent deploy that reduced P99 only applied to a single model path and didn't affect the majority of traffic. We did complete a postmortem and two mitigations but we don't have evidence of sustained reduction across customer-facing endpoints yet.

Proposal: set reliability to 5/10 and include a one-paragraph narrative that (a) acknowledges the shortfall, (b) notes mitigations completed, and (c) lists the pledge: implement CI performance regression + weekly telemetry review for 90 days (owner: Markus/Platform). Mina — I added suggested wording to the leadership_priority_pledges.md (see attachment).

Laura
Product Lead, Core Platform
laura@redwood.com

Also, on Developer funnel: Mina, can you add a line calling out the week-1 drop-off in the narrative and point to the experiment we plan for July? That will make the QBR conversation concrete.

Thanks — Marissa

- RB-Platform reliability: set to 5/10, marked as "contested" with a one-line rationale (see okr_scores_master.ods).
- Leadership priority pledges: added Laura's CI/regression pledge and assigned Markus as owner. Also added the Developer funnel experiment for July with Marissa as owner.
- Narrative edits: inserted a short risk paragraph for the Developer funnel drop-off and included the two customer quotes from the evidence appendix.

Links/next steps: final artifacts are live here: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/EOQ_MINA_evidence. I will use the approved language for the QBR deck. Please tell me now if any of the pledge owners need to be changed — otherwise I'll mark these as committed and close the loop after the 4:15pm review.
